name: antigravity-codex-bridge
description: Asynchronous two-way messaging between running Antigravity and Codex conversations over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Send asynchronous messages between Antigravity and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Discover running conversations and exchange asynchronous messages between Antigravity (App, CLI, IDE) and Codex (CLI, Desktop) over local MCP tools without version pinning.
defaultPrompt: List local Antigravity conversations and send a message to the one I name.
Reply to the Antigravity conversation that sent me the latest bridge message.
Run bridge_doctor to check Antigravity and Codex bridge connectivity.
